newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - Le Monde - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Le Monde - July 30.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Bill on creation of some 350,000 public sector jobs for the young to be presented to cabinet on August 20. Measures to include creation of renewable five-year contracts, with pay at least equal to minimum wage (SMIC).
-- Fast-food chain Burger King, a unit of Britain's Grand Metropolitan Plc to pull out of the French market due to insufficient profitability.
-- Usinor fails in bid for privatisation of Spanish steel group CSI.

-- Former minister Michel Delebarre, in charge of implementing a dialogue with France Telecom unions over a possible partial privatisation, met with CGT and FO unions yesterday. Unions said they expected the government to go ahead with a partial sale.
